home.heading: Embodied intelligence & autonomous systems
paragraphs: The group works on embodied robotics, aerial vision-language navigation, and agent-driven robotic systems. Topics include perception, learning, and autonomous decision-making in physical environments.

Xiaoguang Ma is a Beiyang Chair Professor at Tianjin University's School of Artificial Intelligence and supervises Ph.D. and master's students. His research covers Physical AI, Agentic AI, AI4Engr, and unmanned systems.
home.recruitment: For postdoctoral, Ph.D., master's, and undergraduate research opportunities in embodied intelligence and AI agents, please email Xiaoguang Ma.

research.title: Embodied Robotics
research.description: Imitation learning and perception-action methods for robotic tasks.

research.title: Aerial Embodied Intelligence
research.description: Visual and spatial reasoning for aerial vision-language navigation, including environment understanding and instruction following.

research.title: Agentic AI for Robotics
research.description: Multimodal large models for robotic navigation and decision-making, including frameworks for autonomous learning and improvement.

news.text: Professor Xiaoguang Ma presented research on autonomous learning and evolution in embodied navigation at Tianjin University's Beiyang Intelligent Computing Forum.
Professor Xiaoguang Ma was invited to the Beiyang Intelligent Computing Forum to give a talk on the transition from physical intelligence to embodied intelligence.

publications.title: ViSA-Enhanced Aerial VLN: A Visual-Spatial Reasoning Enhanced Framework for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
publications.abstract: Combines perception, verification, and execution with structured visual prompts to improve spatial reasoning in UAV vision-language navigation.

publications.title: SE-VLN: A Self-Evolving Vision-Language Navigation Framework Based on Multimodal Large Language Models
publications.venue: ACSAT 2026 (as listed on the school website) · arXiv:2507.13152
publications.abstract: Combines hierarchical memory, experience retrieval, and reflection so vision-language navigation agents can accumulate experience and improve decisions during testing.
publications.note: The preprint was first released in 2025. This page lists it under 2026 based on the conference information on the school website.

publications.title: Subconscious Robotic Imitation Learning
publications.abstract: Inspired by subconscious behavior, the method uses intention-aware sampling and cognitive offloading to reduce redundant reasoning and improve execution efficiency in dual-arm robotic imitation learning.

publications.title: M3DSS: A Multi-Platform, Multi-Sensor, and Multi-Scenario Dataset for SLAM System
publications.abstract: Provides synchronized data across robotic platforms, sensors, and complex environments to support the evaluation and comparison of SLAM systems.

publications.title: Frefusion: Frequency Domain Transformer for Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
publications.abstract: Studies infrared and visible image fusion using a frequency-domain Transformer.

teachers.name: Xiaoguang Ma
teachers.role: Beiyang Chair Professor · Supervisor of Ph.D. and Master's Students
teachers.bio: Xiaoguang Ma holds a Ph.D. in Mechanical Control from the University of California, Berkeley. He has worked in industrial research and development and university teaching, and joined Tianjin University's School of Artificial Intelligence in 2026. He teaches Introduction to Embodied Intelligence and related practical courses.
